item.description: A 4-year-old child is still recovering after reportedly being struck in the head with a glass bottle thrown from a float during the Krewe of Zulu parade on Mardi Gras Day.

item.title: Louisiana SNAP EBT restricts soda and sugary drink purchases
item.description: Any beverage marketed or sold as soda, soft drink, sports drink, energy drink, flavored water or juice drink containing less than 100% juice must be left out of your shopping cart if you're a SNAP EBT benefit receiver.
